verdict.rationale: MX is a financial-data platform that also markets AI-driven features such as personalized guidance and plain-language money questions, so an AI-training data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any control, policy, or setting that keeps customer or end-user data out of AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
